name: fidelity-studio-content-assistant
description: Edit authorized website projects, pages, blog posts and team profiles, and draft newsletters where the project enables Resend.

interface.shortDescription: Edit website content and draft newsletters.
interface.longDescription: Connects Fidelity Studio's authenticated website-content MCP and Resend's hosted newsletter MCP. The bundled skill loads scoped client guidance first, follows each project’s review and publishing workflow, keeps direct newsletter work draft-and-test-only, and leaves production newsletter delivery manual in Resend.
defaultPrompt: Authenticate with Fidelity Studio Content Assistant.
Show me my authenticated project context and available workflows.
Help me draft a website update using the workflows available to my project.
